help: doctor                   Inspect deployment without claiming actuator outputs.
move <forward|backward>  Drive for a bounded duration, then stop.
turn <left|right>        Perform a fixed turn sequence.
sensor <type>            Read distance or grayscale sensors.
spi transfer <HEX>       Run one bounded full-duplex SPI transaction.
line-track <start|stop>  Track a line in foreground or stop the motors.
self-drive <action-name> Run one named preset gesture, movement, or sound.
sound <operation>        Play audio, set volume, play music, or stop audio.
voice-chat <start|stop>  Run the local voice chatbot or request shutdown.
voice-active-car <start|stop> Run the sensor-aware base voice car.
voice-active-car-gpt <start|stop> Run the English Buddy voice car.
voice-prompt-car <start|stop> Run the spoken movement demonstration.
calibrate                Interactively calibrate steering and camera servos.
-h, --help               Show this help text and exit.
--speed N                Movement speed from 0 through 100 percent; default 50.
--duration S             Movement duration in seconds; default 1.0.
--angle N                Turn, pan, or tilt angle in degrees.
--volume N               Audio volume from 0 through 100 percent.
SPI HEX                  Optional 0x prefix and 2 through 512 hexadecimal digits.
shake-head               Run the decreasing head-shake gesture.
nod                      Run the repeated camera-tilt nod gesture.
wave-hands               Run the steering wave gesture.
resist                   Run the steering and camera resistance gesture.
act-cute                 Run the low-speed cute-shaking gesture.
rub-hands                Run the small steering-angle rubbing gesture.
think                    Run the thinking pose and return to center.
twist-body               Run the motor, steering, and camera twist gesture.
celebrate                Run the mirrored celebration gesture.
depressed                Run the downward camera-tilt gesture.
forward                  Drive forward briefly and stop.
backward                 Drive backward briefly and stop.
honking                  Play the horn sound in the background.
start-engine             Play the engine-start sound in the background.
